verdict.rationale: MoQ ships its own documented programmatic interfaces: Rust and TypeScript libraries with FFI bindings, plus moq-net/@moq/net for data channels. These let code publish and subscribe to broadcasts through the relay, and the docs are exposed via llms.txt. However, no OpenAPI or HTTP control-plane API for managing the relay was found (all OpenAPI probes returned 404). Programmatic use is therefore through protocol libraries rather than a documented service API. missing for 10: documented relay management/control API, OpenAPI/REST spec, evidence of AI agents driving it via the API, independent corroboration of API docs depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Libraries for Rust (native) and TypeScript (web), plus FFI bindings for C, Python, Kotlin, Swift, Go, and Dart.
Chat, game state, telemetry, and control channels over the same relays with [`moq-net`](/lib/rs/moq-net.html) or [`@moq/net`](/lib/js/net.html).
Dynamic announcements, connecting arbitrary publishers to subscribers.
